column4: componentize-py and wasm-tools are not installed on this runner, and these five tests need a real Python guest: they drive a pending child await through the component boundary and observe whether the guest runs on, which only executing one can show. Whole tests with no dialect arm, so the job's DSNs do not change the count. Declared under all four keys that reject a new ./engine/ toolchain skip -- multi-db/mysql, multi-db/mssql, cluster, and test-go/engine (the last required by scripts/check-skips.sh's pairing rule; engine-race.yml is scheduled and does not run on PRs, so that count is the rule applied, not a reading of its report). Same mechanism as the sibling TestPythonGuest tests, measured on cleat#3432's multi-db/mysql, multi-db/mssql and cluster job reports. NOT yet measured on this PR's own jobs; CI is the first reading. (cleat#3429)
